svg.text: CUSPELL | GESTURE PROPOSALS — FIRST THREE PAIRS
Blue = stroke 1 Orange = stroke 2 Purple = stroke 3 Numbered dots = proposed starting points
NOT recovered historical stroke order. Approved silhouettes are unchanged; directions are candidates for review.
01 G111 / G112 · Outer return + inner rising hook
1. Outer U / return 2. Inner descending hook
Review directions, pen lifts and comfort; these are NOT changes to the glyphs themselves.
02 G113 / G114 · Folded upper sweep + separate diagonal
1. Upper folded sweep 2. Detached lower diagonal
Review directions, pen lifts and comfort; these are NOT changes to the glyphs themselves.
03 G115 / G116 · Connected upper arch + lower fork
1. Upper arch and underline 2. Lower left leg 3. Lower right leg
Review directions, pen lifts and comfort; these are NOT changes to the glyphs themselves.
